name: Clepsydra
author: Erin Carter
description: A water clock rendered in light: a glowing drop detaches from a spout on an exact beat and falls with gravity easing into a faint etched vessel, where a luminous pool flashes a splash ring at each impact and climbs drop by drop — then a smooth siphon draws the level down to nearly empty and the cycle begins again, the drain itself the clock's chime.

params.label: Drop rate
params.effect: Drops per second — slow settings feel like a patient temple clock with long dark pauses, fast settings become a glittering trickle.

params.label: Fill period
params.effect: Seconds for one full rise-and-siphon cycle — how slowly the pool level climbs and how often the draining chime arrives.

params.label: Vessel width
params.effect: Width of the vessel in CSS pixels, from a narrow column of caught light to a broad shallow basin spanning most of the frame.
